scope: Structured events and logs; not metrics-only or distributed tracing

hardware.disk: Local NVMe; pin exact model, capacity, filesystem, and IOPS before running
hardware.load_generator: Separate host; measure CPU, memory, network, and encoding cost independently

corpus.source: One deterministic, shared event corpus; begin from the existing million-event generator
corpus.fields: Preserve timestamps, full messages, service/resource identity, typed attributes, and event identifiers
corpus.rule: Scale the generator, never obtain larger datasets by repeating the same records

profiles.distribution_shift: Swap common and rare state frequencies halfway through live replay
late_arrivals: 1% arriving up to one hour late
profiles.reporting: Independent cases, not a full Cartesian product and not a pooled score

durability.validation: Crash and restart; reconcile acknowledged event IDs and exact counts
durability.power_loss: Separate profile requiring a documented fsync guarantee; do not equate it with process-crash survival
durability.non_equivalent_guarantees: Do not rank throughput together when acknowledgement guarantees differ

phases: Bulk load, including index/summary construction and all required preprocessing
Read-only query runs with explicit cold and warm cache conditions
Live mixed read/write replay with new timestamps and controlled offered load
Storage and resource sampling during ingest and after declared settling

load.arrival_model: Open-loop scheduled requests; include queue delay, backpressure, timeouts, and failures
load.freshness_clock: Load-generator send time to first query visibility, including request and queue delay; also record acknowledgement-to-visible separately
load.throughput_qualification: Highest sustained rate with matching durability, no data loss or unbounded backlog, and P95 freshness <= 1 second
load.overload_results: Publish failures and lag; do not silently omit unsuccessful requests

queries.window: last 24 hours at a fixed corpus anchor
queries.order: event timestamp descending, stable event ID tie-break

queries.window: last 24 hours at a fixed corpus anchor
queries.predicate: exact lowercase token timeout in a controlled space-delimited message corpus
queries.order: event timestamp descending, stable event ID tie-break
queries.rule: Validate token boundaries and returned IDs; do not substitute substring search

queries.window: last seven days at a fixed corpus anchor
last seven days at a fixed corpus anchor
queries.operation: identifier lookup and exact distinct count
queries.rule: Secondary capability test; mark unsupported rather than fabricating an equivalent operation

query_measurement.summary: Median of five per-run P95 values, with range and raw samples linked; never pool different query semantics
query_measurement.cold: Declare OS/page-cache and engine-cache reset procedure; report individual first-run timings, not an invented percentile from a few samples
query_measurement.precomputation: Record every index and summary. Compare raw-query and equivalent precomputed-dashboard profiles separately; include construction, refresh lag, and storage costs
query_measurement.unsupported: Null result with an explicit reason; never zero or simulated latency

accounting.storage: Allocated bytes for all required data, indexes, summaries, journals, metadata, and any local/object-store files; include the full event detail
accounting.settling: Report end-of-load, peak, and settled footprint; declare wait duration and compaction state rather than silently force-merging one engine
accounting.cpu: All required server processes and preprocessing; record client-side encoding separately
accounting.memory: Sum simultaneous RSS across required server processes; also report cgroup/host memory including file cache separately
accounting.client: Separate dashboard profile: browser CPU, peak memory, compressed wire bytes, and time to equivalent complete results
accounting.cost: Derive only after fixing measured resource use and dated hardware/service prices; do not mix self-hosted and SaaS list prices
